title: Entity Batch Creator
text: Create batch of entities, 1 input, 5 outputs, {Event actions} sets the event action; {Number of entities in batch} sets the number of entities in one batch, {Entity type name} sets the name of the batched entity that is created after combining incoming entities, {Bus object} sets the whether to output the batched entity as a bus, {Input entity name} sets the names to be attached to the input entities, {Number of entities arrived, a} sets the outputs the number of entities that have arrived, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities departed, {Number of entities remaining for next batch, rem} sets the outputs the number of entities remaining for the next and {Pending entity in block, pe} sets the pending entities. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Output batch entity scalar | vector | matrix
